findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Dangerous Sinks Discovery
 * @description Finds calls to subprocess, tarfile, and other potentially dangerous APIs
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/dangerous-sinks
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-078
 *       external/cwe/cwe-022
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::Node call, string type
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "check_call", "check_output", "Popen", "run"]).getACall() and
    type = "subprocess"
  ) or
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("tarfile").getMember("open").getReturn().getMember("extractall").getACall() and
    type = "tarfile extraction"
  ) or
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("tarfile").getMember("TarFile").getReturn().getMember("extractall").getACall() and
    type = "tarfile extraction"
  )
select call, "Potential dangerous call to " + type
findings.hypothesis: Check for dangerous sinks like subprocess and tarfile extraction.
Arguments to subprocess calls in rebuild.py are derived from function parameters, potentially allowing command injection if the function is called with untrusted input.
